item.text: I’ll first inspect the existing project structure, then build the smallest app that fits its current stack: a reading list, add and finish actions, and shareable book detail links backed by a JSON file.

There’s no existing app framework in this workspace, so I’m building this as a lightweight Node app with a static front end and a small JSON-backed API. Book detail pages will use stable IDs in the URL, so the same link works after a restart.

The main flows are in place: books start on the Reading shelf, the Finished shelf is separate, and each book has a stable detail URL with a copy-link action. I’m adding startup and storage notes now, and smoothing out persistence behavior if a file write ever fails.

item.text:
Implemented a small reading list app with a Reading shelf, a Finished shelf, an add-book form, and a detail page for each book with its title, author, and notes. The detail page has a **Copy link** button.

Books persist in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json). Start the app with `npm start`, then open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000). Visitors to the same running app share the list. More setup details are in [README.md](/workspace/README.md).

I haven’t run the app or tests in this session.
